project.title: Relay Collaboration
project.definition: A shared operational picture for teams responding to an incident.

domains.title: Coordination
domains.definition: The responsibility boundary for publishing and acknowledging incident decisions.

domains.title: Access Control
domains.definition: The responsibility boundary for incident workspace authority.

capabilities.title: Decision Broadcast
capabilities.definition: Publish an operational decision and distribute it to active responders.

capabilities.title: Acknowledgement Tracking
capabilities.definition: Show which responders have acknowledged a decision.

capabilities.title: Workspace Authorization
capabilities.definition: Evaluate whether a member may read, coordinate, or administer an incident.

competencyAnswers.scope: Incident responders maintaining a shared operational picture.
competencyAnswers.domains: Coordination owns decisions; Access Control owns workspace authority.
competencyAnswers.abilities: Decision broadcast, acknowledgement tracking, and workspace authorization realize the outcome.
competencyAnswers.evidence: README responsibilities, the system map, and workspace packages triangulate the claims.
competencyAnswers.impact: Policy changes can block publication while realtime changes affect decision distribution.
